stemMd: A uniform wire is replaced by one of the same material and temperature, twice as long and twice as large in cross-sectional area. How does resistance change?
explanationMd: Resistance is resistivity times length divided by area. Doubling both length and area leaves their ratio unchanged, with resistivity fixed by the conditions.

distractorRationale.b: The two factors act in opposite directions.
